script:
set -e
TOK=$(cat ~/.cache/huggingface/token)
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
if [ -d /workspace/kazbek-tiles/.git ]; then (cd /workspace/kazbek-tiles && timeout 60 git fetch -q origin main && git reset -q --hard origin/main); else git clone -q https://github.com/GauchoAI/kazbek-tiles /workspace/kazbek-tiles; fi
curl -sfL -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -o /tmp/l.ply https://huggingface.co/datasets/miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets/resolve/main/checkpoints/kazbek-run-l-gtmax/kazbek-run-l-gtmax.ply
export DENO_INSTALL=$HOME/.deno
command -v $DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || (curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh -s -- -y >/dev/null 2>&1)
STAGE=/workspace/kt3l-stage-24/world/kazbek-c10
mkdir -p $STAGE
cd /workspace/kazbek-tiles
$DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-net --node-modules-dir=auto encode/build-tiles.ts /tmp/l.ply $STAGE/tiles-l-g24 --grid 24 --sh 1
$DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno run --allow-read --allow-net --node-modules-dir=auto decode/verify-tiles.ts $STAGE/tiles-l-g24 /tmp/l.ply | tail -2
python3 -c "from huggingface_hub import HfApi; HfApi().upload_large_folder(folder_path='/workspace/kt3l-stage-24', repo_id='miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets', repo_type='dataset', print_report=False)"
echo KT3-L-G24-DONE
